mapper.insert: INSERT INTO content_playback(user_id, content_id, session_id, session_started_at, sequence, watched_ms, video_position_ms, image_index, image_elapsed_ms, audio_position_ms) VALUES(#{userId}, #{contentId}, #{state.sessionId}, #{state.sessionStartedAt}, #{state.sequence}, #{state.watchedMs}, #{state.videoPositionMs}, #{state.imageIndex}, #{state.imageElapsedMs}, #{state.audioPositionMs}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE session_id = CASE WHEN THEN #{state.sessionId} ELSE session_id END, watched_ms = CASE WHEN THEN #{state.watchedMs} ELSE watched_ms END, video_position_ms = CASE WHEN THEN #{state.videoPositionMs} ELSE video_position_ms END, image_index = CASE WHEN THEN #{state.imageIndex} ELSE image_index END, image_elapsed_ms = CASE WHEN THEN #{state.imageElapsedMs} ELSE image_elapsed_ms END, audio_position_ms = CASE WHEN THEN #{state.audioPositionMs} ELSE audio_position_ms END, sequence = CASE WHEN THEN #{state.sequence} ELSE sequence END, session_started_at = GREATEST(session_started_at, #{state.sessionStartedAt})
